landing.title: Selftend
landing.subtitle: Calm, guided self-help tools for personal reflection.

landingPage.heroSupport: Calm, guided self-help - CBT and ACT modules plus eight everyday tools. No ads, no subscriptions.
landingPage.cbtBody: A focused section built around thought records, distortion awareness, and quiet review.
landingPage.actBody: Skills for handling difficult feelings while doing what matters - acceptance, defusion, committed action.
landingPage.step1Body: Pick one module or one small tool. No intake quiz, no setup.
landingPage.step2Body: Sessions are short, and nothing expires.
landingPage.step3Body: Look back over your entries when you're ready - they stay yours.
landingPage.privacyBody: Your entries are encrypted at the field level - a leaked database backup exposes only ciphertext. No ads, no subscriptions, no tracking.
